description: Apple IIgs emulator, a Windows port of Kent Dickey's KEGS
notes: The original emaculation.com download is behind a bot challenge; this package is that official file archived by the Wayback Machine.
Requires an Apple IIgs ROM file named ROM, ROM.01 or ROM.03 next to kegs32.exe, or select a ROM from the configuration panel (F4); the selection is saved in the persisted config.kegs.
